```sql
WITH fx AS (
    SELECT rate_date, aud_nzd_rate
    FROM staging.stg_erp__fx_rates
),
pos_rev AS (
    SELECT
        t.txn_date,
        s.region_code,
        CASE 
            WHEN t.currency = 'AUD' THEN t.line_total * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
            ELSE t.line_total
        END AS net_rev
    FROM staging.stg_pos__transaction_lines t
    JOIN staging.stg_erp__stores s ON t.store_id = s.store_id
    LEFT JOIN fx ON t.txn_date = fx.rate_date
    WHERE t.txn_date BETWEEN '2025-11-24' AND '2025-11-30'
      AND t.is_valid = TRUE
),
ecom_rev AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_date,
        o.region_code,
        CASE 
            WHEN o.currency = 'AUD' THEN l.line_total * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
            ELSE l.line_total
        END AS net_rev
    FROM staging.stg_ecom__orders o
    JOIN staging.stg_ecom__order_lines l ON o.order_id = l.order_id
    LEFT JOIN fx ON o.order_date = fx.rate_date
    WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-11-24' AND '2025-11-30'
      AND o.order_status != 'cancelled'
),
erp_rev AS (
    SELECT
        sol.order_date,
        c.region_code,
        CASE 
            WHEN sol.currency = 'AUD' THEN sol.net_value * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
            ELSE sol.net_value
        END AS net_rev
    FROM staging.stg_erp__sales_order_lines sol
    JOIN staging.stg_erp__customers c ON sol.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN fx ON sol.order_date = fx.rate_date
    WHERE sol.order_date BETWEEN '2025-11-24' AND '2025-11-30'
),
all_rev AS (
    SELECT region_code, net_rev FROM pos_rev
    UNION ALL
    SELECT region_code, net_rev FROM ecom_rev
    UNION ALL
    SELECT region_code, net_rev FROM erp_rev
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(net_rev) AS DOUBLE) AS answer
FROM all_rev ar
JOIN reference.regions r ON ar.region_code = r.region_code
WHERE r.region_name = 'Christchurch'
```
